description: This file defines the AttributeService class for interacting with telemetry attributes and timeseries data via HTTP requests in an Angular application. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting entity attributes and timeseries, utilizing Angular's HttpClient and RxJS.

classes.name: AttributeService
classes.description: Angular service for managing entity attributes and timeseries data via REST API calls.

methods.name: getEntityAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves attributes for a specified entity, optionally filtered by scope and keys.

methods.name: deleteEntityAttributes
methods.description: Deletes specified attributes for an entity within a given scope.

methods.name: deleteEntityTimeseries
methods.description: Deletes timeseries data for an entity, with options for range and data deletion specifics.

methods.name: saveEntityAttributes
methods.description: Saves or updates attributes for an entity, handling null or undefined values appropriately.

methods.name: saveEntityTimeseries
methods.description: Saves or updates timeseries data for an entity, handling null or undefined values.

methods.name: getEntityTimeseries
methods.description: Retrieves timeseries data for specified keys within a time range, with options for aggregation and ordering.

methods.name: getEntityTimeseriesLatest
methods.description: Retrieves the latest timeseries data for specified keys.
